product_one_liner.value: Speak_ is an AI recruiting assistant that screens and ranks applicants against recruiter-defined criteria, helping recruiting teams identify qualified candidates and integrate evaluations with their ATS.

pricing_page.notes: Public pricing is a section of the homepage, with Free, Pro, and Enterprise plans; Pro is listed at $199/month.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn reports 18 employees; PitchBook reports 20 as of 2025. Both fall within this band.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index contains recruiting, interview preparation, career, and community content, not two engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: No product-documentation or help-center link is shown; the homepage has a single FAQ section. The separate tech-interview preparation guide is educational content, not documentation for the recruiting product.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: No company careers page or employee job board could be located; applicant roles handled by the product and jobs at the unrelated language-learning company were excluded.

model_provider.notes: No underlying AI model or provider is identified in the product FAQ, blog, updates, privacy policy, or terms reviewed. The privacy policy refers to unnamed AI tools; Google APIs are described as data sources, not model providers. No public subprocessor list was located.

compliance_certs.notes: No certification claim was found. The privacy policy discusses GDPR legal bases, but does not claim GDPR certification; this was not treated as a certification.

last_funding.notes: Aventure reports the most recent funding as $20,000 in March 2025 and identifies the Techstars accelerator. Techstars confirms the March 2025 cohort and seed investment but does not disclose the company-specific amount. PitchBook dates the accelerator entry January 2025 and leaves its amount blank; the month and amount here follow Aventure, with that discrepancy noted. A later Early Stage VC entry on PitchBook is marked cancelled.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified completed financing is the 2025 Techstars investment, announced in March, before the 2025-05-09 window start. No later completed round was found; the later PitchBook VC entry is cancelled.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No company careers page or employee job board could be located; no defensible yes/no hiring determination is available.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable company post history identifies a launch-type Lever integration enhancement on 2025-05-12, before the 2026-05-09 window start. Later visible posts are not product launches. The website updates are undated and cannot establish a more recent launch.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The complete four-person team page lists one C-level executive, co-founder and CEO Andrea Guendelman, already identified as CEO in June 2025. It lists no VP; no in-window C-level or VP appointment or departure announcement was found.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The readable integration announcement names ATS products, not CRM or sales/marketing systems. ATS compatibility is not evidence that Speak_ itself uses a CRM.
